t: 提图斯的军队在经过了六个月的围攻后进攻了耶路撒冷的城墙. 三天后他们突破了城墙,这使得军队可以…
te: The armies of Titus attack the walls of Jerusalem after a six-month siege. Three days later they breach the walls, whic…
dz: 提图斯的军队在经过了六个月的围攻后进攻了耶路撒冷的城墙. 三天后他们突破了城墙,这使得军队可以摧毁第二圣殿.
de: The armies of Titus attack the walls of Jerusalem after a six-month siege. Three days later they breach the walls, which enables the army to destroy the Second Temple.

t: 提图斯和他的军队攻破了耶路撒冷的城墙。 （希伯来历搭模斯月 17 日）。
te: Titus and his armies breach the walls of Jerusalem. (17th of Tammuz in the Hebrew calendar).
dz: 第一次犹太罗马战争：提图斯和他的军队攻破了耶路撒冷的城墙。 （希伯来历搭模斯月 17 日）。
de: First Jewish–Roman War: Titus and his armies breach the walls of Jerusalem. (17th of Tammuz in the Hebrew calendar).

t: 提图斯,卫斯巴相皇帝之子,在圣殿山以北的安东尼亚要塞被风暴所袭. 罗马军队被拉入街头与泽阿洛特…
te: Titus, son of emperor Vespasian, storms the Fortress of Antonia north of the Temple Mount. The Roman army is drawn into…
dz: 围攻耶路撒冷:提图斯,卫斯巴相皇帝之子,在圣殿山以北的安东尼亚要塞被风暴所袭. 罗马军队被拉入街头与泽阿洛特人交战.
de: Siege of Jerusalem: Titus, son of emperor Vespasian, storms the Fortress of Antonia north of the Temple Mount. The Roman army is drawn into street fights with the Zealots.

t: 因耶路撒冷第二圣殿被摧毁而起的火灾被扑灭.
te: Fires resulting from the destruction of the Second Temple in Jerusalem are extinguished.
dz: 因耶路撒冷第二圣殿被摧毁而起的火灾被扑灭.
de: Fires resulting from the destruction of the Second Temple in Jerusalem are extinguished.

t: 提图斯在摧毁了希律寺后,结束了对耶路撒冷的包围.
te: Titus ends the siege of Jerusalem after destroying Herod's Temple.
dz: 提图斯在摧毁了希律寺后,结束了对耶路撒冷的包围.
de: Titus ends the siege of Jerusalem after destroying Herod's Temple.

t: 在前一天被希律王宫攻克后,提图斯手下的一支罗马军队固守并掠夺了耶路撒冷城.
te: After the capture of Herod's Palace the previous day, a Roman army under Titus secures and plunders the city of Jerusal…
dz: 在前一天被希律王宫攻克后,提图斯手下的一支罗马军队固守并掠夺了耶路撒冷城.
de: After the capture of Herod's Palace the previous day, a Roman army under Titus secures and plunders the city of Jerusalem.
